# Nested field matching

The ten unchanged `nested_field_match` originals, including `_004_go` and
`_007_go`, come from [pinned Bend flatten tests](https://github.com/bendlang/bend/tree/e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599/tests/flatten).
Copyright 2026 HigherOrderCO; Apache-2.0. See NOTICE and
`licenses/Apache-2.0.txt`.

The function-valued mains qualify checking and normalized structure/text,
not generated execution. Original code generation lacks Base; separate authored
probes add Base and prefix local names, confirming function-printer refusal.
`applications.tsv` records direct pinned interpreter applications, observed twice,
covering five Nat depths and all relevant field/parameter combinations. Rust tests
apply the same original definitions and compare actual core structures and text.
